narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__M1B02DD2:

DATA QUALITY: Analyzed 221 working days with 1 outliers detected. 
Demand data winsorized to [54.61, 1482.99] range.

DEMAND PROFILE: Material exhibits smooth demand with mean daily consumption of 762.53 units 
and CV of 40.83%. No significant trend detected. 
Distribution type: normal.

LEAD TIME: Average lead time is 2.56 days with moderate variability (CV=47.30%). 
Effective lead time including buffer: 3.78 days.

SAFETY STOCK: To achieve 95% service level, recommended safety stock is 1728 units, 
significantly higher than current SAP safety stock of 701 units. This increase is driven by lead time 
variability (CV=47.30%).

ORDER POLICY: EOQ calculation suggests optimal order quantity of 10934 units, but storage capacity constraints 
limit this to 5030 units. Reorder point set at 3683 units with review period of 7 days.

COST IMPACT: Recommended policy reduces total annual cost from $56,318.38 to $4,011.55, 
saving $52,306.83 (92.9%). The savings come primarily from reduced ordering frequency 
(from 748 to 39 orders/year), despite higher holding costs.

SAFETY LEAD TIME: Analysis recommends 2.27 days, suggesting current setting of 3.00 
days could be reduced. Transport factors dominate lead time variability (60%).
warnings: Order quantity adjusted from 10935 to 5030 due to constraints
